# Sojan O Nelson

> Cybersecurity Analyst & Full-Stack Software Engineer specializing in web application security, ethical hacking, penetration testing, and scalable full-stack web development.

## Executive Summary

Sojan O Nelson is a Technology Designer, Cybersecurity Analyst, and Full-Stack Software Engineer based in India. He holds a Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) degree in Cloud Computing and Ethical Hacking from East West College of Management, Bangalore (2022–2025). 

Sojan bridges the gap between offensive cybersecurity and software engineering. He designs and develops resilient, high-performance web applications, IoT solutions, and automation systems while conducting threat modeling, vulnerability assessments, and security audits to ensure application security by design.

## Technical Competencies

### Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking
- **Penetration Testing & Vulnerability Assessment**: Web application security, network protocol analysis, security audits, threat modeling, OWASP Top 10 mitigation.
- **Security Tools & Platforms**: Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, Wireshark, TryHackMe, Hack The Box, OWASP ZAP.
- **Security Domains**: Cryptography, Network Security, Web Application Firewalls, Cloud Infrastructure Security, Secure Code Auditing.

### Software Engineering & Full-Stack Development
- **Frontend Stack**: React.js, Next.js (App Router, Static Export), Vite.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Framer Motion, Lottie Animations, Figma.
- **Backend Stack**: Node.js, Express.js, Python, RESTful API Design, JWT Authentication, Session Management, Microservices.
- **Databases**: MongoDB (Atlas/Mongoose), Firebase Realtime Database & Firestore, MySQL.
- **DevOps & Developer Tools**: Linux (Ubuntu, Kali Linux), Git, GitHub, Docker, Postman, Insomnia, VS Code, Vercel, Render.

### Emerging Tech & AI/ML
- **Machine Learning**: KNN, K-Means Clustering, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow.
- **Audio & Media**: Web Audio API for digital music beat creation and audio processing.

### Personal & Open-Source Projects

#### 3. ChordBeats
- **URL**: [chordbeat.vercel.app](https://chordbeat.vercel.app)
- **Category**: Web Audio / Music Production
- **Stack**: React.js, Web Audio API, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB
- **Key Features**: Digital studio web application allowing users to compose music beats, play virtual instruments, and synthesize custom sound loops directly in the browser.

#### 4. Automated Vulnerability Scanner
- **Category**: Cybersecurity Tool
- **Stack**: Python, BeautifulSoup, Nmap, Request Library
- **Key Features**: Security scanner script created for automated discovery of web application vulnerabilities, open ports, header misconfigurations, and outdated software versions.

#### 5. Personal Voice Assistant ("Lara")
- **Category**: Artificial Intelligence & Automation
- **Stack**: Python, TensorFlow, Eel (GUI Framework), SpeechRecognition, Pyttsx3, MongoDB
- **Key Features**: Desktop voice-controlled virtual assistant capable of launching system applications, fetching web intelligence, taking notes, and executing computer commands via voice prompts.

#### 6. Spotify Clone
- **Category**: Streaming Media Application
- **Stack**: React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Spotify Web API
- **Key Features**: Interactive media player replicating key Spotify features including user authentication, playlist creation, track search, and audio playback.

#### 7. Lunchify
- **Category**: Web Application / Organizational Tools
- **Stack**: React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB
- **Key Features**: Food coordination and meal ordering management system built for institutional teams to streamline daily lunch orders.

#### 8. Online Learning Platform
- **Category**: EdTech
- **Stack**: React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Firebase
- **Key Features**: E-learning portal featuring course catalog management, video lecture streaming, and quiz assessments.

#### 9. Personal Portfolio Website
